packageRules.description: Upstream's normal releases are plain `stable-NNNNN`; hotfixes append `-1`, `-2`, ... A pattern requiring the suffix silently skips every normal release, and one forbidding it silently skips every hotfix (both happened). The optional group compares as 0 when absent, ordering `stable-11146` < `stable-11146-2` < `stable-11500` correctly. Hotfixes rank as patch updates, so patch-automerge can gate them once a Molecule scenario exists.
